name: Lunch
time_basis: Removed so a time from the Beresford example is not paired with Encounter Bay menu words (CD review D1). Kicker used instead.
line: Shared private chef curated Mediterranean-inspired lunch

line_source.document: FULL DAY (8HR) RETREAT NAIKO ENCOUNTER BAY 2026.pdf

detail: Private shared 3 course mediterranean-inspired lunch with Award-Winning Chef, Luca Guiotto of Aromi Dining. Enjoy a fresh, seasonal, plant-forward lunch showcasing the finest local South Australian ingredients, where every course tells a story through bold flavours and elegant presentation.

detail_source.document: FULL DAY (8HR) RETREAT NAIKO ENCOUNTER BAY 2026.pdf

dishes: Poached beetroot carpaccio style, local goats cheese, kohlrabi, white balsamic dressing, macadamia, mint
House-made hummus, organic vegetables crudité, “Peninsula Providore” marinated olives and Greek pita bread
Baked eggplant parmigiana, “La Vera” fresh mozzarella, rich house-made tomato sugo, basil pesto
Locally caught yellow eyed mullet, fennel velouté, kalamata, burnt oranges, salmoriglio dressing
Double cooked organic potatoes, parmigiano, chives
Miso baked pumpkin, pepitas, freshly picked herbs
Sauteed greens, preserved lemons, toasted almonds

review: Seven dishes across three courses as published. Whether the example menu is public is decision 8, the public flag switches it.
